create_RNDConfig_default: create an RNDConfig instance with default predictor learning rate of 1e-4 and single SGD step per step
create_RNDConfig_custom_lr: create an RNDConfig with a custom predictor learning rate for the RND agent
create_RNDConfig_sequence_based: create an RNDConfig with is_sequence_based set to true for SequenceAdder data format
create_RNDConfig_sgd_steps: create an RNDConfig with multiple SGD steps per step for faster convergence
summarize_RNDConfig: summarize the RNDConfig dataclass which holds predictor learning rate, sequence mode, and SGD step count
